decision.statement: A containsText assertion whose expected value is empty after Playwright normalizeWhiteSpace never passes; it reports ASSERTION_FAILED. F4 parity is unchanged for every non-empty expected value.
rationale: Vacuous pass is a false pass; OBS-009 AC-7 D-C has zero false passes as a hard gate and OBS-010 AC-1 gates the pilot on it
Introduced by H6 (a 015 change); before H6 the case usually failed
Not invented (Article IV): extends the existing blank-value read refusal (observationCollector.ts:728, runtime.ts:415) to the expected side
Rare in plain-English steps, so a runner backstop suffices; rarity does not justify a vacuous path
